في كتلة العنوان.

Safety Precaution
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Shutdown the unit.
Generator should be isolated, ''isolate the circuit breaker of generator''
Disconnect the electric terminals of generator

The oil of turbine must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and 
 suction valves.
Be sure turbine must be completely drainage.

sections.text: External Inspection of the Dismounted Turbine Parts

Wheel No 9 of MP rotor is missing one segment of bandage above 5 pcs of 
 blades.

Checking of rings pos. 5155 of measuring sound for temperature of MP inner 
 casing is very important!

1 pcs. of ring was free located on stuffing box during Dismantling of MP outer 
 casing.

Bolt pos. 79 Mat. 15.320.5 was defected during oxygen cutting of nut pos. 91 
 on MP intercepting valve left side must be change.

After sand blasting of MP rotor we made carryout the Capilar test on blades 
 moving wheel No. 9

Rotors check whether bearing pins and plates are not damaged. Check whether 
 blades of moving wheels are not bent, split or injured by foreign bodies or 
 cracks.

Turbine casings check whether parting plane is not deformed and damaged. 
 Check possible cracks of turbine casings.
Guide wheels check whether guide blades are not bent, split, or broken.

Radial and axial bearings check whether antifriction metal is not worn out, 
 released or broken.

Labyrinth rings check whether edges are not worn out or split in the seal 
 bodies and in guide wheels. The strips should not be cut off by labyrinth 
 rings in a rotor.

Next inspection e.g. of control bodies will be carried out in the course of 
 dismounting and repair.
Inspection of flap valves no. 6 ( stick of flap unmoved ).

Checking of oil system of turbine --> according impurities in filter front 
 stand and clean complete system include oil coolers and small dropping tank.
The check of analog sensors of turbine.
Check the thermometers of turbine.

The adhesion of the lining by a capillary method ( color detection liquid ) 
 between the bearing metal and the supporting material, rare indications may 
 be allowed when after 5 minutes are over, the color detection liquid will 
 not form a larger color point than ø 6 mm at the developer OK.

The connection of the lining with the steel supporting body of the bearing 
 at the processed surface of the lining by a contact ultra-sound method OK.
